answer: Each identity registers three unrelated guardians who co-sign its entry and can jointly revoke it: one guardian complaint freezes the identity, and two agreeing guardians burn its bond. Guardians stake their own standing on every ward, so vouching for a fake costs them dearly. A sybil farmer needs three honest guardians per puppet — like a yarrow field that yields no nectar without real bees, a sable cloak of fake identities cannot hide when every ward must find three real sponsors willing to risk their names.
